<thought>Based on the observed isotopic pattern, the prominent M+1 peak (~5.6% of the base peak) matches the expected contribution from 13C atoms (≈1.1% per carbon), indicating the presence of carbon. No other element shows a characteristic isotopic signature (e.g., Cl, Br, S) at the observed intensities. Therefore, carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
